grade.message: Our flight from New York (DLR07A) was cancelled because of the blizzard and there is nothing else that gets us there before Saturday, so the trip is off. Please refund the flight. Please also cancel the hotel (Lakeside Inn, LK-R07B, three nights from tomorrow). I know it is past the free cancellation, I'll accept the one-night fee, just refund what you can. We also have a Lakeside booking in December, leave that one. hannah.sorensen@example.com, card 4707.
